scope: exact identical .atto source bytes, not identical machine code or security sandbox

expected.rolling_digest_rule: digest = checked_i64(digest * 31 + post_message_state) in global send order, starting from 0

required_evidence.compilation: real .atto compiler generates application-specific native guest code (no runtime interpreter)
required_evidence.source_identity: exact source Git blob SHA and SHA256 in compiled-guest manifest
required_evidence.runtime: native binary/tenant VM executes the guest; provide exact executable CI job SHA
required_evidence.observable_guest_return: return 43 must be observed in executed native guest
required_evidence.extended_message_telemetry: message counts and rolling digest may be claimed only if runtime actually exposes them
required_evidence.tenant_security: independently enforced and adversarially tested; never implied by actor-owned arenas
required_evidence.zero_gc: independently measured with collector counters, RSS bounds and arena reclamation

llvm.reason: previous LLVM source-guest CI ran other .atto programs; identical M4 fixture not yet compiled

graalvm-native.reason: previous GraalVM source-guest CI ran identical source bytes at source repo location, but M4 cross-backend workflow not yet independently checked

notes: Do not label a host C test, byte-identical source, scalar-only AOT, or LLVM linker build as cross-backend actor-executed parity.
LLVM tenant VM must report return/result evidence independently of GraalVM's synchronous-only pilot; missing instrumentation remains NOT_OBSERVED.
Actions on PR merge refs or incomplete/check-skipped jobs are not accepted as exact source-head guest proof.
